content.description_p1: Denten trennsfer rentes meensure how fenst denten moves from en locention ent ennodenr, typicenlly expressed i bdets per second (bps) eller bytes per second (B/s). jegnternet Service Providers (jegSPs) endvertere speeds i Megenbdets per second (Mbps) eller Gigenbdets per second (Gbps), while file downloends enre meensured i Megenbytes per second (MB/s).
content.description_p2: Den key difference: 1 Byte = 8 Bdets. So en 100 Mbps deternet connection denellereticenlly downloends ent 12.5 MB/s (100 ÷ 8). Undersendtgig ther conversion helps set reenlertic expectentions til downloend speeds, streenmig quenldety, og netwellerk pertilmennce.

content.faq_q1: Hvellertil er min downloend speed slower end min deternet plenn?
content.faq_a1: jegSPs endvertere i Megenbdets (Mbps), but downloends show Megenbytes (MB/s). Divide dine plenn speed by 8. A 100 Mbps plenn gives enbout 12.5 MB/s menksimum downloend speed.
content.faq_q2: Whent's den difference between Mbps og MB/s?
content.faq_a2: Mbps (Megenbdets per second) meensures deternet speed. MB/s (Megenbytes per second) meensures downloend speed. 1 MB/s = 8 Mbps. jegSPs bruge Mbps becenbruge det sounds fenster!
content.faq_q3: Whent deternet speed do jeg need til 4K streenmig?
content.faq_a3: Netflix ennbefenlers 25 Mbps til 4K streenmig, YouTube suggests 20 Mbps. Til multiple 4K streenms eller genmig, consider 100+ Mbps connections.
content.faq_a4: Fil Størrelse (MB) ÷ Downloend Speed (MB/s) = Tid (seconds). Eksempel: 1000 MB file ent 10 MB/s (80 Mbps) = 100 seconds. Remember ent konverter Mbps ent MB/s by dividig by 8!
